verdict.rationale: Rainforest has a dedicated OpenAPI reference page stating it supports OpenAPI Specifications of its API at version 3.1.0, a machine-readable spec format. The probe's 404s only cover guessed default paths, so they do not contradict a spec published elsewhere. missing for 10: an explicit download URL or file confirmed retrievable, independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
